name: Set Up Door Frame Paint Protection
intent: Floor protection at frame base, wall masking adjacent to frame (spray only), and fixture covers (spray only) before door frame finish coats. Same pattern as trim paint protection — slower install rates than prime phase because the painter works carefully around already-finished wall/ceiling surfaces adjacent to the frame.
doctrine: Rates are cloned from MOD_SETUP_TRIM_PAINT_PROTECT because door frame protection uses the same materials and constraints as trim paint protection. Floor protection at 300 SF/hr and fixture cover at 30 EA/hr intentionally slower than prime phase — painter working around finished surfaces. V1b: pass_group_id: [null] gate skips these when door_frame is a finish_group_assignment member — ps_keys (FLOOR_PERIMETER, WALL_ADJACENT, ASSET.FIXTURES) are room-level aggregates shared with trim, so MOD_SETUP_FINISH_GROUP fires the equivalent task_refs once per group.
